title: Capability Genesis finds an installed tool by its behaviour against a founder-signed contract before it builds
problem: A function outside the five-entry CATALOG went straight to the builder, even when a tool already installed on the body does exactly what the founder's contract asks (acceptance C.G3); no test pinned acquire-before-build route order (C.G5).
baseline: #196 head d35d92a5: an uncatalogued function with a contract routes installed_software:'no catalogued installed tool or oracle for this function' then builder; text.line_count costs one build.

alternatives.name: Proposed: fixed auditable template set screened on public examples, qualified on held-out vectors
alternatives.description: 19 read-only single-file filters; each runs isolated with no network through the existing binary route; selection is by behaviour, verification through the serving adapter.
advantages: Reuses run isolation, hash pin, licence read, attach rules and restore
disadvantages: Covers only functions a one-file text filter can compute
Templates are code-resident, so new ones need a review

alternatives.name: Enumerate every executable on PATH and guess argv
disadvantages: Runs arbitrary untrusted binaries with guessed flags, including writers and network tools
alternatives.revival_evidence: A sandbox strong enough to run unknown binaries with guessed flags safely, plus a cost bound

alternatives.name: Installed Python distributions via importlib.metadata
alternatives.description: Discover packages whose entry points fit the contract.
disadvantages: Needs a per-package call template; no safe generic signature
alternatives.revival_evidence: A recurring deficit an installed package could serve, with a declared call contract (recorded as C.G3 residual)

alternatives.name: Ask a model to propose the invocation
alternatives.description: LLM proposes argv for installed tools.
disadvantages: Model output would choose what runs; needs the builder's authority posture
alternatives.revival_evidence: A model route already confined and budgeted for proposals

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Every uncatalogued function pays for a build even when a commodity tool already does it.
disadvantages: Build spend and founder attention on solved problems

roles.position: Acquire before building, at the level of behaviour rather than names.
material_concerns: Do not claim open-ended discovery; the set is fixed

roles.position: One new route inside Genesis.resolve between verified_detached and builder; no second registry.
material_concerns: genesis.py is shared with WU-11 and #244/#250 (adjacent-line conflicts only)
evidence_refs: git merge-tree results in the PR

roles.position: Public examples screen, held-out vectors decide; detached tools are never re-registered.
material_concerns: A filter that matches by coincidence on few vectors

roles.position: Searches are memoized by an installed-binary fingerprint so a failed search does not re-run every tick.
material_concerns: Fingerprint hashing reads each binary once per search

roles.position: No authority change: attach still requires a signed read-only auto_attach or the founder.
material_concerns: A found tool must wait when attach is not pre-authorized

evidence.claim: Uncatalogued text.line_count is served by installed wc -l with no build
evidence.finding: ACHIEVED, builder.calls == [], ATTACHED after restart; fails on d35d92a5

evidence.claim: Capability dividend is caused by discovery
evidence.finding: with DISCOVERY_TEMPLATES emptied, the same mission calls the builder once

counterevidence.claim: Discovery generalizes to any uncatalogued function
counterevidence.finding: false: markdown.unchecked_count matches no template; 19 of 19 tried, builder still needed

pass_1.intended_outcome: An uncatalogued function a commodity tool already computes is acquired, verified and attached without a build.

advantages.statement: Build spend avoided whenever an installed filter fits
advantages.amplified_value: Every recurring text/digest/ordering deficit closes from the body's own software

disadvantages.redesigned_response: Stated in the route text and C.G3 residual; builder remains the next rung

disadvantages.statement: Running templates costs time on every resolution
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Fingerprint memo; screening on public examples before full verification
Held-out vectors through the serving adapter decide; schema requires at least 3

comparisons.baseline: Baseline builds for every uncatalogued function; proposed builds only when no template behaves as the contract says.
comparisons.do_nothing: Do nothing keeps paying builds for solved problems.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: The proposed fixed set is itself the simplest viable route.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: importlib.metadata package discovery: broader, but no safe generic call contract.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Empty DISCOVERY_TEMPLATES to disable without touching anything else.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack: re-registration of founder-detached tools, re-running failed searches, held-out bypass, unbounded execution.

new_weaknesses.statement: Discovery could re-register a tool the founder detached
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: DETACHED and QUARANTINED ids are skipped and the skip is recorded; mutant caught

new_weaknesses.statement: A failed search re-runs every tick
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Memo on installed fingerprint plus unusable ids; mutant caught
Verification vectors are public plus held-out; mutant caught

pass_2.final_design: Fixed set of 19 read-only one-file filter templates screened on public examples, qualified on public plus held-out vectors through the serving adapter, DETACHED/QUARANTINED skipped, failed searches memoized by installed fingerprint; builder only when nothing matches.

migration_plan: None needed; existing catalogued routes are unchanged and restore reads the recorded origin.

steps: Set DISCOVERY_TEMPLATES = () to disable the route

kill_criteria: A discovered tool attaches while failing any held-out vector
A template writes outside its scratch directory or reaches the network
review_trigger: First real mission served by a discovered tool, or a proposal to widen the template set
